text.tr: Hafta sonu odanı kendin boyadın. Akşam olunca boya kokusu başına yerleşti.
text.en: You painted your room yourself this weekend. By evening the paint smell had settled into your head.

dialog.speaker: roommate
dialog.en: The plant in the hallway is drooping. It was standing tall yesterday.

dialog.speaker: roommate
dialog.tr: Rengi güzel ama. Bu gece bende yer yatağı var, istersen.
dialog.en: Nice color, though. There's a floor mattress in my room tonight, if you want it.

choices.en: Window open, sleep in your room
Sleep on the living room couch

cam.tr: Cam açık, yorgan iki kat. Sabah baş ağrısı geçmişti, burnun akıyordu.
cam.en: Window open, double blanket. By morning the headache was gone and your nose was running.

coach.en: The window worked in both directions.

yer.tr: Yer yatağında uyudun. Ev arkadaşın gece iki kez uykusunda rengin adını sordu.
yer.en: You slept on the floor mattress. Twice in the night your roommate asked, still asleep, what the color was called.

coach.tr: Cevap iki kez verildi: kum beji.
coach.en: The answer, given twice: sand beige.

kanepe.tr: Kanepede uyudun, sabah boynun kanepenin kolunu taklit ediyordu. Oda kurudu.
kanepe.en: You slept on the couch. By morning your neck had taken on the shape of the armrest. The room dried.

coach.en: The wall: even. The neck: slightly curved.

intent.setup: kiralık odayı kendin boyayıp akşam boya kokusundan baş ağrısı
intent.mechanism: ev arkadaşı kokuyu koridordaki bitkiden ölçüyor
